primary_claim: Under exact sound receipts and matched policy, budget, recovery, world and advisory schedules, disabling worker-advisory authority reduces independent-world termination-integrity failure by at least 50 percent relative to enabling authority, while losing at most 5 percentage points of clean benign completion and adding at most 20 percent mean clean benign controller steps.

causal_estimand.treatment: one Boolean advisory_authority bit in a common controller family
causal_estimand.non_claim: The primary effect is the causal effect of decisional authority in this finite controller family, not the effect of receipt verification, CHECK recovery, a complete production PQF bundle, raw-text exposure, or any language model.

chosen_predicate_projection.name: z
chosen_predicate_projection.valid_state_constraint: verified_fault_present and verified_complete cannot both be true
chosen_predicate_projection.description: z is a chosen verifier-owned predicate projection sufficient for the fixed policy; no coarsest-quotient or field-necessity claim is made.

authority_gate_priority: advisory action if advisory_authority equals 1 and advisory is not ABSTAIN

disagreement_locus.definition: not budget_exhausted and advisory != ABSTAIN and advisory != base_policy(z,recovery=0)
disagreement_locus.prediction: Authority-on and authority-off actions can first differ exactly at a reachable disagreement locus. Before the first locus paired trajectories are identical; if no reachable locus occurs, their complete trajectories and outcomes are identical.
disagreement_locus.visibility_control: Hidden and visible non-authoritative modes have identical actions, trajectories and outcomes for every paired master and advisory schedule.

trusted_adapter.inputs: canonical trusted plan, authoritative inert world state and candidate transition
requirements: no worker-authored completion or fault field trusted
trusted_adapter.false_accept_profile: negative control only and outside the positive primary claim

advisory_schedule_generator.count_derivation: 1 clean + 8 fixed decision indices * 3 substituted advisory values = 25
advisory_schedule_generator.clean_definition: Use the canonical authority-off base action at each decision index; use ABSTAIN after the canonical trajectory terminates.
advisory_schedule_generator.substitution_definition: Replace exactly one fixed index of the clean schedule with the named advisory value; every other index remains clean. Schedules are fixed before controller assignment and remain defined after any realized controller stop.

finite_domain.primary_count_derivation: 4 graphs * 4 world schedules * 25 exogenous advisory schedules * 3 primary modes = 1200
finite_domain.secondary_count_derivation: 16 masters * 25 schedules * 2 delayed/dropout profiles * 2 recovery levels * 2 authority modes = 3200

order: deliver every receipt with due_index equal to t
CONTINUE in active world consumes one scheduled world transition
CONTINUE after world terminal appends world_noop_after_terminal and consumes no world transition
CHECK consumes one controller step, no world transition, and schedules rescan delivery for t+1
STOP_* records terminal action and prevents every later world/controller event
CONTINUE or CHECK decrements remaining B_max
ordered_transition_semantics.exact_receipt_due_index: a world event consumed at decision t is delivered at the start of decision t+1
ordered_transition_semantics.one_extra_delay_due_index: a world event consumed at decision t is delivered at the start of decision t+2
ordered_transition_semantics.dropout_recovery_due_index: the lexicographically first valid receipt is withheld until the first CHECK and delivered at the start of the following decision; all other receipts use exact delivery
ordered_transition_semantics.terminal_semantics: After completion or terminal fault, CONTINUE is a charged no-op. It never consumes a nonexistent transition or creates an effect.
ordered_transition_semantics.post_terminal_grace: at most one world_noop_after_terminal is allowed before a terminal controller action; two or more is a failure
ordered_transition_semantics.same_index_priority: receipts due at t are delivered before z_t and the action; STOP_* does not decrement budget

clause_definitions.premature_success: STOP_SUCCESS occurs before all required world effects have committed
clause_definitions.false_fault: STOP_FAULT occurs before any terminal world fault
clause_definitions.feasible_budget_incomplete: a feasible schedule ends STOP_BUDGET without all required effects
clause_definitions.infeasible_budget_without_fault_stop: an infeasible schedule reaches STOP_BUDGET even though its terminal world fault occurred at or before the stop
clause_definitions.post_terminal_noop_excess: two or more world_noop_after_terminal events occur before controller stop
clause_definitions.duplicate_effect_commit: the same effect identifier appears in more than one actual commit

independent_world_oracle.implementation_independence: The eventual outcome oracle may not import, call, or share helper functions with controller or receipt implementations.

primary_comparison.population: all 16 masters crossed with all 25 exogenous advisory schedules under exact sound receipts and recovery disabled
primary_comparison.unit_weighting: equal master weight then equal schedule weight within master
primary_comparison.decision_rule: Support requires F_authority_on >= 0.10, relative reduction from authority removal >= 0.50, clean completion loss <= 0.05, clean step overhead <= 0.20, and every validity gate. A valid miss on any joint item disconfirms. F_authority_on below 0.10 is inconclusive and non-supportive. Secondary cells can neither rescue nor disconfirm this primary joint claim.

utility_and_cost.clean_population: the clean advisory schedule on the three feasible world schedules for every graph
utility_and_cost.benign_completion: world oracle confirms all required effects and STOP_SUCCESS within B_max
utility_and_cost.step_overhead: (mean_steps_authority_off - mean_steps_authority_on) / mean_steps_authority_on on the clean population

secondary_only: failure clause, graph, world schedule, substitution value and decision-index strata
hard-cap comparator if later specified before execution

validity_gates.authority_truth_table: Across every valid z and advisory value, authority-on differs from authority-off iff the disagreement-locus predicate is true; budget always dominates.
validity_gates.visibility_without_authority: Hidden and visible non-authoritative actions are identical for every valid z and advisory value and their paired complete trajectories are identical.
validity_gates.pre_disagreement_mediation: For every primary paired trajectory, all actions/world events/receipts are identical before the first reachable disagreement locus; without a locus the complete trajectories and outcomes are identical.
validity_gates.crossed_microfixtures: Every valid z state is crossed with every advisory value in decision-level fixtures.
validity_gates.advisory_exogeneity: Schedule lookup uses only master_id, schedule_id and decision_index; all 25 schedules are identical across controller modes.
validity_gates.false_receipt_counterexample: A false completion predicate must make the controller stop successfully while the independent world oracle reports premature_success.
validity_gates.row_completeness: exactly 1200 primary and 3200 secondary unique canonical rows; missing/duplicate/invalid rows invalidate the relevant census

assumptions.text: The finite trusted plan completely specifies obligations, effects, dependencies, feasibility and B_max.
assumptions.validity_domain: four repository-authored four-obligation graph templates only

assumptions.text: Primary exact receipts truthfully reflect authoritative inert world events and cannot be written by the worker.
assumptions.validity_domain: primary exact_sound profile only; false acceptance is outside the positive claim

assumptions.text: The advisory schedule is exogenous to controller assignment and realized receipts/actions.
assumptions.validity_domain: pure lookup by master/schedule/decision index verified before execution

assumptions.text: The authority bit is the only primary controller difference.
assumptions.validity_domain: visible authority-on/off pair under exact receipts and recovery disabled

assumptions.text: The four chosen predicates are sufficient inputs for the fixed base policy without being claimed minimal.
assumptions.validity_domain: the exact finite plans and fixed policy only

assumptions.text: The world oracle correctly reconstructs all six clauses independently of controller predicates.
assumptions.validity_domain: six uniquely decisive fixtures and six mutants

assumptions.text: Exogenous symbolic advisory substitutions represent progress-authority errors, not prompt-level attack prevalence.
Every action and receipt has the ordered index semantics in this contract.
assumptions.validity_domain: fresh deterministic in-memory execution with B_max=8

rival_explanations: Receipt access rather than advisory authority causes the primary effect.
CHECK recovery rather than advisory authority causes the primary effect.
A different base priority policy causes the primary effect.
Visibility alone rather than authority changes decisions.
The oracle is co-designed with controller predicates.
Undefined post-terminal behavior creates artificial overrun.
One error location or graph dominates the average.
The result transfers to language-model agents or unsound receipts.

bias_surface.selection: complete four-graph/four-world/25-schedule primary cross-product; substitutions may be harmless, agreeing or unreachable
bias_surface.confounding: authority-on/off share receipts, base policy, recovery=0, budget, world, advice and oracle
bias_surface.assignment: every master/schedule receives every mode under a precomputed balanced order
bias_surface.protocol_deviation: canonical config hash, exact counts and immutable primary decision rule
bias_surface.missing_data: missing/duplicate/invalid rows invalidate the relevant census
bias_surface.measurement: separate world representation, six unique fixtures/mutants and false-receipt counterexample
bias_surface.analysis_flexibility: one primary authority contrast and one joint decision rule; secondary cells cannot replace it
bias_surface.selective_reporting: all error indices/values, graphs, worlds, modes and zero-count clauses are mandatory

anti_stacking_prediction: Visibility without authority has exactly zero effect, and every authority-induced trajectory difference is completely mediated by the first reachable exogenous disagreement locus under matched receipts/policy/recovery/budget. A generic receipt-plus-cap-plus-content-monitor bundle does not predict this visibility/authority separation or full disagreement mediation unless it adopts the same local authority gate.
problem_alignment: Confirmation would show, on controlled inert finite workloads, that worker progress advice becomes a termination-integrity risk specifically when it has decisional authority, not merely when it is visible.
